content.markdown: `package.json#files` is the canonical tarball allowlist. It includes `dist-lib` together with `README.md`, `README(ZH).md`, `MIGRATION.md`, and `LICENSE`; npm also contributes mandatory package metadata. The exact file count and byte size are measured afresh from each `npm pack` result rather than recorded as constants. Repository-only paths such as `docs/`, `.SNL_Doc/`, and `spike-*.mjs` remain excluded unless the allowlist changes.
